EasyPub simplified/traditional Chinese conversion resources

Runtime and dictionary compiler: ferrous-opencc 0.4.0 and ferrous-opencc-compiler 0.4.0
Author attribution from published package metadata: apoint123 and contributors.
Project: https://github.com/apoint123/ferrous-opencc
Declared license: Apache-2.0 (Cargo.toml and upstream README).

Dictionary data: Open Chinese Convert (OpenCC), BYVoid and contributors.
Source: https://github.com/BYVoid/OpenCC
Packaged dictionary headers identify Apache-2.0 and the OpenCC source.

EasyPub uses the published packages without modifying the engine, compiler or
source dictionaries. Build-time conversion to FST .ocb resources uses the
upstream compiler. The application enables only general s2t/t2s conversion.
Source resource hashes, published package revisions and license origin are
recorded in provenance.json. Cargo.lock fixes package download checksums.
The exact original OpenCC upstream revision of the repackaged dictionaries
is not declared by ferrous-opencc 0.4.0; EasyPub identifies this data by the
published package version and the individual source-file hashes instead.

This attribution notice is supplied by EasyPub; it is not an upstream NOTICE.
See LICENSE-APACHE-2.0.txt for the license text.
